name: Task List

endpoints.description: Fetch all tasks, optionally filtered by status and sorted by due date

query_params.name: status
query_params.description: Filter by status: todo, in_progress, done, or all

query_params.name: sortBy
query_params.description: Field to sort by; only 'dueDate' is currently supported

query_params.name: order
query_params.description: Sort direction when sortBy=dueDate: asc or desc

error_codes.condition: status query param is not one of todo, in_progress, done, all
Tasks fail to load due to a database error

business_logic: 1. Parse query params (status, sortBy, order) with defaults → if status is not one of todo/in_progress/done/all: return 400 VALIDATION_ERROR
2. Query all tasks from DB, filtering by status if status != 'all'
3. If sortBy=dueDate: sort results ascending/descending by due_date per order param, with null due_date tasks last → else: order by created_at descending (default)
4. Return 200 with task array (empty array if none match)

data_operations.description: SELECT tasks WHERE status = ? (if filter active) ORDER BY due_date [order] NULLS LAST or created_at DESC (default)

edge_case_handling.handling: Return 200 with empty array; frontend displays empty state 'No tasks yet.' with an Add Task prompt
Return 500 INTERNAL_ERROR; frontend displays error banner with a retry button

business_rules_applied: All tasks are shown by default with no filter applied
Tasks with a past due date are marked overdue only if their status is not Done (computed client-side)

endpoints.description: Update an existing task's title, due date, and/or status

error_codes.condition: title is present in body but empty
Task with given id does not exist

business_logic: 1. Check task exists → if not found: return 404 NOT_FOUND
2. If title is present in body and empty: return 400 VALIDATION_ERROR
3. UPDATE provided fields on the task, set updated_at=now
4. Return 200 with updated task

data_operations.description: UPDATE task SET title/due_date/status (only provided fields) WHERE id=?

edge_case_handling.handling: Return 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with message 'Title is required'; task remains unchanged
Frontend-only — no API call made; task remains unchanged

business_rules_applied: Task title is required and cannot be cleared on edit
Due date and status can be changed freely

query_params.name: status
query_params.description: Filter by status: todo, in_progress, done, or all

business_logic: 1. Parse status query param → if 'all' or absent: no filter applied
2. Query tasks WHERE status = ? if filter is active
3. Return 200 with filtered task array (empty array if no matches)

data_operations.description: SELECT tasks WHERE status = ? (if filter active)

edge_case_handling.handling: Return 200 with empty array; frontend displays 'no results' message (not an error)
Return 200 with the full unfiltered task list

business_rules_applied: Filter options are Todo, In Progress, Done, plus an 'All' option to clear the filter
Filtering is applied immediately — no submit action required
When no tasks match the filter, a 'no results' message is shown (not an error state)

unit_test_cases.expect: return 200 with array containing only tasks whose status === 'in_progress'

unit_test_cases.description: returns 200 with empty array when no tasks match the filter
unit_test_cases.given: req.query.status = 'done'; taskRepo.findByStatus('done') returns []
unit_test_cases.expect: return 200 with body [] (not an error)

unit_test_cases.description: returns success result when all conditions pass
unit_test_cases.given: req.query.status = 'todo'; taskRepo.findByStatus('todo') returns a valid matching array
unit_test_cases.expect: return 200 with the filtered task array

endpoints.description: Fetch tasks sorted by due date

query_params.name: sortBy
query_params.description: Field to sort by; only 'dueDate' is currently supported

business_logic: 1. Parse sortBy and order query params → default sortBy=none, order=asc
2. If sortBy=dueDate: query tasks ordered by due_date [order], with null due_date tasks last
3. Apply sort on top of the currently active status filter, if any
4. Return 200 with sorted task array

data_operations.description: SELECT tasks (WHERE status = ? if filter active) ORDER BY due_date [order] NULLS LAST

edge_case_handling.handling: Second click on the sort control flips the order param between asc/desc and re-fetches

business_rules_applied: Tasks without a due date always appear after those that have one, regardless of sort direction
Sort is applied to the currently filtered list if a filter is active

unit_test_cases.description: sorts tasks by due date ascending with nulls last when sortBy=dueDate&order=asc
unit_test_cases.given: taskRepo.findAll() returns tasks with mixed and null due dates; req.query = { sortBy: 'dueDate', order: 'asc' }
unit_test_cases.expect: return 200 with array sorted by dueDate ascending, null-dueDate tasks placed last

unit_test_cases.description: sorts tasks by due date descending with nulls last when sortBy=dueDate&order=desc
unit_test_cases.given: taskRepo.findAll() returns tasks with mixed and null due dates; req.query = { sortBy: 'dueDate', order: 'desc' }
unit_test_cases.expect: return 200 with array sorted by dueDate descending, null-dueDate tasks placed last

unit_test_cases.description: applies sort on top of an active status filter when both are present
unit_test_cases.given: req.query = { status: 'todo', sortBy: 'dueDate', order: 'asc' }; taskRepo.findByStatus('todo') returns matching tasks with mixed due dates
unit_test_cases.expect: return 200 with array containing only status='todo' tasks, sorted by dueDate ascending, nulls last

unit_test_cases.description: returns success result when all conditions pass
unit_test_cases.given: req.query = { sortBy: 'dueDate', order: 'asc' }; taskRepo returns a valid task array
unit_test_cases.expect: return 200 with the sorted task array

screen_dependencies.reason: Add Task and Edit Task actions open the Task Form modal to capture/edit task fields

implementation_notes: Overdue indicator is computed client-side (dueDate < today && status !== 'done') — not returned as a backend field
SQLite has no native NULLS LAST; sorting by due date needs a CASE WHEN due_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, due_date [order] workaround
No pagination — full result set is returned on every call, per shared-decisions
API should be bound to localhost only per NFR — no auth enforced at the application layer
